{"id":1919035864,"question_id":4137,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"5 months, 1 week","timestamp":1771080695,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1919035864/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Number of Prefix Connected Groups","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int prefixConnected(vector<string>& words, int k) {\n        unordered_map<string , int>mp;\n\n        for(auto word : words){\n            if(words.size() < k) continue;\n            string str = word.substr(0 , k);\n            mp[str]++;\n        }\n\n        int ans = 0;\n        for(auto it : mp) if(it.second >= 2) ans++;\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"number-of-prefix-connected-groups","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1701}
